title: #49 Company Workers
prompt: In the company, some people think the employers should involve the workers in decision making. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages.

requirements.en: Discuss the important advantages and disadvantages.
requirements.vi: Thảo luận những ưu điểm và nhược điểm quan trọng.
Đưa ra nhận định tổng thể theo yêu cầu.

requirements.en: Support the comparison with relevant examples.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ phần so sánh bằng ví dụ phù hợp.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Involving workers in decisions makes the work environment better because staff feel more valued and work together more happily.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Involving workers in decisions makes the work environment better because staff feel more valued and work together more happily.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Worker ideas help the company run smoothly because staff who do the work every day know the problems best.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Worker ideas help the company run smoothly because staff who do the work every day know the problems best.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Involving staff in planning makes them feel more connected and proud of the work, leading them to work harder and generate better ideas.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Involving staff in planning makes them feel more connected and proud of the work, leading them to work harder and generate better ideas.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Workers have superior knowledge of daily tasks, allowing the company to proactively fix potential problems, such as machine breakdowns.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Workers have superior knowledge of daily tasks, allowing the company to proactively fix potential problems, such as machine breakdowns.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Worker involvement improves the quality of work because employees contribute practical knowledge, leading to better products and outcomes.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Worker involvement improves the quality of work because employees contribute practical knowledge, leading to better products and outcomes.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Involving staff boosts morale and job satisfaction because employees feel respected and valued, which reduces stress and improves commitment.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Involving staff boosts morale and job satisfaction because employees feel respected and valued, which reduces stress and improves commitment.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point discusses how involving workers increases job satisfaction and morale.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point discusses how involving workers increases job satisfaction and morale.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point explains that workers possess valuable, practical knowledge about the company's operations.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second point explains that workers possess valuable, practical knowledge about the company's operations.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not list advantages and disadvantages without making the required judgement.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ liệt kê ưu nhược điểm mà quên đưa ra nhận định bắt buộc.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
